audit.whatIsWrong: The page never named a single Ambessa ability. Every tracking field said 'Repeating Dashes', which is not in her kit. Public Execution's suppression and heal, Repudiation's brace-shield and Lacerate were all absent.
audit.why: Public Execution blinks 1250 units, suppresses then stuns, and heals her; Repudiation deals increased damage if she blocked non-minion damage while bracing, so poking into the brace feeds it. Drakehound's Step gives her a free dash plus an empowered auto off any cast.
audit.corrected: focus, tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, cooldowns, dos and donts now use the real names with 130s/18s/13s cooldowns, and anti-heal is called for.
